# Character XP HUD regression image

`level-61-0.579-user-20260910.png` is the original-resolution HUD crop supplied
by the Grindcrest user on September 10, 2026. It shows the large character level
61 above the smaller experience percentage 0.579%. The image is used only in
tests and is not embedded in the application. Original Black Desert imagery
© Pearl Abyss Corp.; this is a user-provided crop, not a public reference URL.

`level-65-38.907-hud-user-20260911.png` is an unmodified 640 × 400 pixel crop
from the user's 3840 × 2160 Black Desert client, captured through Grindcrest's
passive window capture on September 11, 2026 while diagnosing missing XP.
It shows level 65 and 38.907%, together with neighboring stats and buff icons.
This keeps the HUD context that caused the original Windows OCR search to fail.
The capture is HDR-tonemapped and carries 144-DPI metadata; tests compose it
using explicit pixel bounds to preserve its actual pixel size. It is used only
in tests and is not shipped with the application. Original game imagery
© Pearl Abyss Corp.; no public reference URL.
